decisions.reasoning: This data analytics platform represents a comprehensive multi-subsystem application that will clearly exceed the 14,000 token threshold. It includes multiple complex subsystems: (1) data connector infrastructure for CSV/database/API sources with different protocols, (2) metric calculation engine with custom expression parsing, (3) visualization rendering system with multiple chart types, (4) interactive dashboard builder with drag-and-drop UI logic, (5) scheduled reporting system with email integration, (6) export functionality with format transformations, and (7) RBAC system. Each subsystem requires substantial implementation code. The data connector layer alone typically requires 3-4k tokens for multiple source types, the visualization system another 3-4k tokens, the dashboard builder 3-4k tokens, and the remaining features collectively 4-6k tokens, totaling 16-20k tokens. This matches the calibration data showing full analytics dashboards truncate at 16k tokens. Natural decomposition boundaries exist: backend data services can be separated from frontend visualization components, with clear API contracts between them.
